en: Stay away from the bees for 100 ticks!
The bees on the board are objects of the world: each one is your `class Bee`.
Change the code: make the bees turn, fly faster, or follow you.
sk: Včely na doske sú objekty sveta: každá je tvoja `class Bee`.
Zmeň kód: nech včely zatáčajú, letia rýchlejšie alebo ťa sledujú.

lesson: # Round 1: make the animal move with the arrow keys.

goal.en: Write `def on_key(key):` and call `go(key)` inside it.
Write `class Bee(Critter):` with an `on_tick(self)`: the world's bees use it.
goal.sk: Napíš `class Bee(Critter):` s `on_tick(self)`: včely sveta ju použijú.

goal.en: Make more bees with a `for` loop: `Bee(x, 0, "south")`.
Pick a twist card and add it to your game. Then press "Test my game".
goal.sk: Vyber si kartu s nápadom a pridaj ho do hry. Potom stlač „Otestuj moju hru“.
